content: To illustrate the difference of predictions between our proposed models, we show an example chosen from the KP20k validation set in Appendix SECREF10 . In this example there are 29 ground truth phrases. Neither of the models is able to generate all of the keyphrases, but it is obvious that the predictions from INLINEFORM0 all start with “test”, while predictions from INLINEFORM1 are diverse. This to some extent verifies our assumption that without the target encoder and orthogonal regularization, decoder states following delimiters are less diverse.
